repairs.failure: The random tiny DeepSeek config initialized every tid2eid entry to zero, so the v1 routing-ID ablation was mathematically inert. The v1 summary also omitted this causal check from its aggregate pass condition.
repairs.change: Install a deterministic non-degenerate synthetic hash table before forward and require both routing-ID and position-ID ablation deltas to be strictly positive.

hard_pass_conditions: projector gradient is finite and nonzero
all frozen language gradients are absent
routing-ID ablation changes logits with inputs_embeds held fixed
position-ID ablation changes logits with inputs_embeds and routing IDs held fixed
interpretation_rule: A pass is software seam evidence using a synthetic tiny route table. It does not pass Gate D and cannot substitute for the full checkpoint tid2eid table, full DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 loading, real FP4/FP8 input-gradient, memory/throughput, checkpoint recovery, or real-image capability evaluation.
